name: Nero
source:
One of the seven Anticross [spoiler]that doesn't exist in this world[/spoiler]. Also known as [Tyrant]. The strongest and the worst Anticross possessing power comparable to that of [url=https://vndb.org/c936]Master Therion[/url]. She contracted with the Grimoire Unaussprechlichen Kulten (無名祭祀書 - The Book of Nameless Rituals) and summon Deus Machina Nameless One.

"How hateful... Don's just leave Nero out of the gang like that."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.demonbane.com/special/]Demonbane Official Site[/url]]

[spoiler]In truth she is the nightmare version of [url=https://vndb.org/c12697]Nero[/url] brought by [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url] as nightmare for her "story". Because of the despair memories that she had to endure in Infinite Spiral, she held a grudge towards her own son [url=https://vndb.org/c936]Master Therion[/url] himself, thus wanted to kill him for vengeance.[/spoiler]
